description: Practical mainnet target tier (§8.1): validates or falsifies the architecture's practical mainnet TPS estimate of 5,000 TPS. Runs one-to-one for 30 minutes; either sustains the target or produces clear bottleneck evidence. See internal-docs/architecture/scaling.md for the throughput model and mainnet targets.
